title: Settings now use a crisp four-section HD menu
summary: A new Settings route organizes controls, display, audio and extras in a compact responsive menu with crisp canvas and DOM typography; the low-resolution ATV thumbnail is replaced by the rendered original model.
details: Host checks passed at 320×568, 390×844, 844×390 and 1280×720, including 2× device scale, keyboard access, all four categories and 44-pixel touch targets.
Persistent settings cover 115% steering sensitivity, mobile mode, minimap shape and size, and crash presentation. Extras expose crash mode plus tight or original crash-camera choices.

UI lifecycle checks passed boot, course and model loading, context restoration, reduced-motion behavior, failed-content handling, touch targets, and portrait/landscape rotation. The short-landscape controls/help ordering was corrected and rechecked.
limitation: Host-only verification. Public deployment and verification have not occurred. This is a refreshed authored browser menu, not recovered native UI rendering.
caption: Host Chromium Settings screen at 390 pixels with four crisp sections
